mapper.select: SELECT id AS factor_id, account_id, encrypted_secret, status, expires_at FROM mfa_factor WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND factor_type = 'TOTP' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id AS factor_id, account_id, encrypted_secret, status, expires_at FROM mfa_factor WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND factor_type = 'TOTP' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mfa_factor SET status = 'REVOKED', encrypted_secret = NULL, revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = 'Superseded enrollment', updated_at = #{now} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND factor_type = 'TOTP' AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mfa_factor (id, account_id, factor_type, encrypted_secret, key_version, status, last_accepted_counter, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{factorId}, #{accountId}, 'TOTP', #{encryptedSecret}, #{keyVersion}, 'PENDING', -1, #{expiresAt}, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO mfa_recovery_code (id, account_id, factor_id, code_hash, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{factorId}, #{codeHash}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE mfa_factor SET status = 'REVOKED', encrypted_secret = NULL, revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND factor_type = 'TOTP' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING')
UPDATE mfa_recovery_code SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{id}, NULL, #{actorAccountId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventType}, 'mfa_factor', #{accountId}, 'SUCCESS', #{reason}, #{now}, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('accountId', #{accountId}::text, 'factorId', #{factorId}::text, 'sessionGeneration', #{sessionGeneration}, 'recoveryCodeCount', #{recoveryCodeCount})))
